sentences.en: The family was going on holiday.
sentences.zh: 这家庭是去在……上假期。

sentences.en: They were taking Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 他们是拿 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad were busy packing the car.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸是忙碌的收拾行囊这汽车。

sentences.en: "Will you pack these for us, please?" Asked Wilma.
sentences.zh: 将你盒这些为了我们， 请？ 问 Wilma。 什么是它？ 问 Wilma。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "There will be lots to do," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 那里将是许多到做， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "You won't need those." "We will," Said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 你不会必须那些。 嗨 Wilf！ 帮助！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "We must take the game station.
sentences.zh: 我们必须拿这游戏火车站。

sentences.en: I've got a great new game." Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我已经得到一个很棒的新的游戏。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: "We want to watch these films," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们想要到手表这些电影， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: "We haven't seen some of them yet."
sentences.zh: 我们没有看见一些的他们还。

sentences.en: "And can we take the CD player?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 和能我们拿这光碟玩？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: [car horn] It was a long journey.
It took hours.
sentences.zh: 它拿他们到罗马。

sentences.en: They stopped for a break.
sentences.zh: 它有到是做完在……之前早饭。

sentences.en: "Let's get a drink" said Mum.
sentences.zh: 让我们得到一些漂流木。 说妈妈。 Kipper， 说妈妈。 是什么那个？ 笑话 Wilf。

sentences.en: At last they arrived at the cottage.
sentences.zh: 在最后的他们到达在这小屋。

sentences.en: "We're in the middle of a forest," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们是在……里这中间的一个为了， 说 Wilf。 帮助！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "We're in the middle of nowhere," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 我们是在……里这中间的哪里都不， 说 Wilma。 » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: They went inside the cottage.
sentences.zh: 他们去里面这小屋。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad began to unpack the car.
sentences.zh: 妈妈和爸爸开始到打开这汽车。

sentences.en: There was a big television in the front room.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个大的电视在……里这前面房间。

sentences.en: "Great," "Great!" said Chip.
sentences.zh: 很棒的！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Let's watch TV."
sentences.zh: 让我们手表电视。

sentences.en: "We could play some games," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们能玩一些游戏， 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: Said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 帮助！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "Could you bring in our game station, Dad?" "Not now," "Later," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 能你带来在……里我们的游戏火车站， 爸爸？ 不现在， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Come and help us unpack the car."
sentences.zh: 来和帮助我们打开这汽车。

sentences.en: At breakfast Wilma put on a film.
sentences.zh: 在早饭 Wilma 放在……上一个电影。

sentences.en: Dad sighed.
sentences.zh: 爸爸叹气。

sentences.en: "Get dressed everyone.
sentences.zh: 得到连衣裙每个人。

sentences.en: We didn't come on holiday to watch TV."
sentences.zh: 我们没有来在……上假期到手表电视。

sentences.en: "Can we watch this first?"
sentences.zh: 能我们手表这个第一？ 问 Wilma。

sentences.en: Said Wilma. "Let's watch TV." "Okay," Wilma said.
sentences.zh: » 说 Nadim。 让我们手表电视。 Wilma 有一个主意。

sentences.en: "Get dressed everyone.
sentences.zh: 得到连衣裙每个人。

sentences.en: We didn't come on holiday to watch TV."
sentences.zh: 我们没有来在……上假期到手表电视。

sentences.en: "Can we watch this first?" Asked Wilma.
sentences.zh: 能我们手表这个第一？ 问 Wilma。 什么是它？ 问 Wilma。

sentences.en: "Later," Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 告诉我后来。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Let's go out."
sentences.zh: 让我们去出。

sentences.en: "Where's the beach today?" Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 有远也许多到做。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: But nobody said anything.
sentences.zh: 但是没有人说任何东西。

sentences.en: Wilf and Biff were busy playing a game.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Biff 是忙碌的玩一个游戏。

sentences.en: Chip and Wilma were listening to a CD.
sentences.zh: Chip 和 Wilma 是听到一个光碟。

sentences.en: Suddenly all the lights went out.
sentences.zh: 突然地全部这轻的去出。

sentences.en: The television and the CD player went off.
sentences.zh: 这电视和这光碟玩去离开。

sentences.en: "What's happened?" Called Biff.
sentences.zh: 是什么发生？ 叫 Biff。 太太梅！ 叫 Biff。

sentences.en: Dad came in with a torch.
sentences.zh: 爸爸来在……里和……一起一个手电筒。

sentences.en: "There's been a power cut," He said.
sentences.zh: 有是一个控制力切！ 他说。 啊唷！

sentences.en: Mum found a lamp.
sentences.zh: 妈妈找到一个灯。

sentences.en: "What if the power doesn't come back on?"
sentences.zh: 什么如果这控制力不来回来在……上？

sentences.en: Asked Chip, looking at the TV.
sentences.zh: Chip， 看在这电视。

sentences.en: "We'll have to do without it," Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我们会有到做没有它， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Oh, no!" Said the children.
sentences.zh: 哦不！ 说这孩子们。

sentences.en: That night the power didn't come back on.
sentences.zh: 那个夜晚这控制力没有来回来在……上。

sentences.en: "It may be off for a long time," Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 它梅是离开为了一个长的时间， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: It was time to eat.
sentences.zh: 它是时间到吃。

sentences.en: They all sat round the table and had supper by candlelight.
sentences.zh: 他们全部坐圆形的这桌子和有晚饭由烛光。

sentences.en: It was fun eating in the dark.
sentences.zh: 它是乐趣吃在……里这黑暗的。

sentences.en: They took it in turns to tell stories.
sentences.zh: 他们拿它在……里转动到告诉故事。

sentences.en: Dad told them a funny story about a time when he was a little boy.
sentences.zh: 爸爸告诉他们一个有趣的故事关于一个时间当……时他是一个小的男孩。

sentences.en: It made them all laugh.
sentences.zh: 它做他们全部笑。

sentences.en: That night the power didn't come back on.
sentences.zh: 那个夜晚这控制力没有来回来在……上。

sentences.en: The children had to use the lamp to go to bed.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有到使用这灯到去到床。

sentences.en: Chip made a shadow on the wall with his hands.
sentences.zh: Chip 做一个阴影在……上这墙和……一起他的手。

sentences.en: "Guess what it is," he said.
sentences.zh: 猜测什么它是， 他说。

sentences.en: Wilma shone a torch under her chin.
sentences.zh: Wilma shone 一个手电筒在……下方她下巴。

sentences.en: The light made her face look scary.
sentences.zh: 这轻的做她脸看可怕的。 她说。

sentences.en: "Ooh!" "Whoooh!" she said.
sentences.zh: 呼呼声！ 哦不！ 她说。

sentences.en: "I'm a monster." Everyone laughed.
sentences.zh: 我是一个怪物。 每个人笑。

sentences.en: Then Mum came in and said it was time to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 然后妈妈来在……里和说它是时间到去到睡觉。

sentences.en: The next morning there was still no power.
sentences.zh: 这下一个早晨那里是仍然不控制力。

sentences.en: So the family spent all day on the beach.
sentences.zh: 所以这家庭花费全部一天在……上这海滩。

sentences.en: They played lots of games.
sentences.zh: 他们玩许多的游戏。

sentences.en: "It's late," Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 它是一个风筝。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "It's time to go."
sentences.zh: 它是时间到去。

sentences.en: "Can't we stay a bit longer?" Asked Wilf.
sentences.zh: 不能我们停留一个一小块长的？ 问 Wilf。 是什么那个？ 笑话 Wilf。

sentences.en: "I've got an idea," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我已经得到一个主意， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Let's build a fire.
sentences.zh: 让我们建造一个火。

sentences.en: We could cook supper."
sentences.zh: 我们能做饭晚饭。

sentences.en: "Brilliant!"
sentences.zh: 明亮的！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Brilliant!" they all shouted.
sentences.zh: 明亮的！ 他们全部喊。

sentences.en: "Let's get some driftwood." Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 让我们得到一些漂流木。 说妈妈。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "I'll go and get the food," Said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我会去和得到这食物， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: It was getting dark by the time the fire was finished.
sentences.zh: 它是得到黑暗的由这时间这火是结束了的。

sentences.en: "Hey, Wilf, that looks like a giant bird's nest," Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 那个看喜欢一个巨人鸟窝， 说妈妈。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "You light it, not lay an egg in it!"
sentences.zh: 你轻的它， 不安放一个鸡蛋在……里它！

sentences.en: Dad cooked lots of food on the fire.
sentences.zh: 爸爸做饭许多的食物在……上这火。

sentences.en: Then Mum toasted some marshmallows.
sentences.zh: 然后妈妈烤面包片一些棉花软糖。

sentences.en: They all sat and looked at the stars.
sentences.zh: 他们全部坐和看在这星星。

sentences.en: "I have a surprise," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我有一个意想不到的事物， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: "Sparklers!" "Sorry," "Sorry," said Dad the next morning.
sentences.zh: 烟花棒！ 我是对不起。

sentences.en: "Still no power."
sentences.zh: 仍然不控制力。

sentences.en: We can do without it," Smiled Chip.
sentences.zh: 我们能做没有它。 哦！ 说 Chip。

sentences.en: "Last night was magic," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 最后的夜晚是魔法， 说 Wilf。 帮助！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "What shall we do tonight?" Asked Biff.
sentences.zh: 什么将我们做今夜？ 问 Biff。 谁是你？ 问 Biff。

sentences.en: That night Wilma had a good idea.
sentences.zh: 那个夜晚 Wilma 有一个好的主意。

sentences.en: "We could play hide and seek," she said.
sentences.zh: 我们能玩把和寻找， 她说。

sentences.en: "If you are 'It' you have a torch."
sentences.zh: 它' 你有一个手电筒。

sentences.en: Everyone hid around the dark cottage.
sentences.zh: 每个人 hid 在……周围这黑暗的小屋。

sentences.en: Wilf was It'.
sentences.zh: Wilf 是它'。

sentences.en: He counted to a hundred.
sentences.zh: 他数数到一个一百。

sentences.en: Wilf looked in every room.
sentences.zh: Wilf 看在……里每个房间。

sentences.en: "Found you, Biff!"
sentences.zh: 找到你， Biff！ 他叫。

sentences.en: He called.
sentences.zh: 来在……上， 他叫。

sentences.en: Biff was hiding behind a big plant.
sentences.zh: Biff 是躲藏在……后面一个大的植物。

sentences.en: He found Chip lying in the bath.
sentences.zh: 他找到 Chip 说谎在……里这洗澡。

sentences.en: Wilma was behind the TV.
sentences.zh: Wilma 是在……后面这电视。

sentences.en: Mum was under a bed.
sentences.zh: 妈妈是在……下方一个床。

sentences.en: But where was Dad?
sentences.zh: 但是哪里是爸爸？

sentences.en: Suddenly, the moon came out from behind the clouds.
sentences.zh: 突然地， 这月亮来出从在……后面这云。

sentences.en: It lit up the windows.
sentences.zh: 它 lit 向上这窗户。

sentences.en: Dad was hiding behind the curtains.
sentences.zh: 爸爸是躲藏在……后面这窗帘。

sentences.en: That gives me an idea," thought Wilma.
sentences.zh: 那个给我一个主意， 想 Wilma。

sentences.en: The next day Biff, Chip and Wilf went with Wilma to the woods.
sentences.zh: 这下一个一天 Biff， Chip 和 Wilf 去和……一起 Wilma 到这木头。

sentences.en: "Why have we brought the boxes and a sheet?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: 为什么有我们带来这盒子和一个床单？ 问 Chip。 什么是它？ 问 Chip。

sentences.en: "And why are we here so early?" Yawned Wilf.
sentences.zh: 和为什么是我们这里所以提早的？ 打哈欠 Wilf。 嗨 Wilf！

sentences.en: "There's loads to do before tonight." Wilma's eyes sparkled.
sentences.zh: 有装载到做在……之前今夜。 Wilma 眼睛发光。

sentences.en: "This evening, we are going to do a shadow play!"
sentences.zh: 这个晚上， 我们是去到做一个阴影玩！

sentences.en: "Brilliant!" Said Chip.
sentences.zh: 明亮的！ 说 Chip。 哦！

sentences.en: "What's that?"
sentences.zh: 是什么那个？

sentences.en: The children worked all day.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们工作全部一天。

sentences.en: They cut out shapes from the cardboard boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们切出形状从这硬纸板盒子。

sentences.en: Wilf tied the sheet between two trees.
sentences.zh: Wilf 租给雇工的这床单在……之间二树。

sentences.en: "What are you doing?" Dad asked.
sentences.zh: 什么是你做？ 爸爸问。

sentences.en: "It's a surprise," said Wilma.
sentences.zh: 它是一个意想不到的事物， 说 Wilma。

sentences.en: Said Wilma.
sentences.zh: » 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: There was a golden sunset that evening.
sentences.zh: 那里是一个金色的日落时分那个晚上。

sentences.en: The children had put down lots of candles in jars.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们有放向下许多的蜡烛在……里震动。

sentences.en: "How beautiful!" Said Mum.
sentences.zh: 如何美丽的！ 说妈妈。 Kipper， 说妈妈。

sentences.en: "It's like magic!" Gasped Dad.
sentences.zh: 它是喜欢魔法！ 喘气爸爸。 它是喜欢魔法！ 喘气爸爸。

sentences.en: Suddenly Biff turned out the lamp.
sentences.zh: 突然地 Biff 转动向上这灯。

sentences.en: The sheet glowed.
sentences.zh: 这床单光亮。

sentences.en: The play began.
sentences.zh: 这玩开始。

sentences.en: It was about elves.
sentences.zh: 它是关于 elves。

sentences.en: The elves were cardboard puppets.
sentences.zh: 这 elves 是硬纸板木偶。

sentences.en: Wilf and Chip moved the puppets around.
sentences.zh: Wilf 和 Chip 移动这木偶在……周围。

sentences.en: Biff did the elves' voices.
sentences.zh: Biff 做这 elves' 说话声。

sentences.en: Wilma played the guitar.
sentences.zh: Wilma 玩这吉他。

sentences.en: They all sang songs.
sentences.zh: 他们全部唱歌歌曲。

sentences.en: It was a good story.
sentences.zh: 它是一个好的故事。

sentences.en: It was funny and sad.
sentences.zh: 它是有趣的和伤心的。

sentences.en: It made Mum laugh and Dad cry.
sentences.zh: 它做妈妈笑和爸爸哭。

sentences.en: The play had finished.
sentences.zh: 这玩有结束了的。

sentences.en: Everyone bowed.
sentences.zh: 每个人呻吟。

sentences.en: "Hooray!" Shouted Mum.
sentences.zh: 这食物是准备好的。 喊 Gran。

sentences.en: "Well done!" "Now," "Now," said Dad "I've got a surprise." "What is it?" Asked Wilma.
sentences.zh: 好做完！ 啊唷！

sentences.en: "You'll see," Smiled Dad.
sentences.zh: 你会看见， 微笑爸爸。

sentences.en: They went back to the cottage.
sentences.zh: 他们去回来到这小屋。

sentences.en: It was pitch black.
sentences.zh: 它是场地黑色的。

sentences.en: "We can't see anything," said Wilf.
sentences.zh: 我们不能看见任何东西， 说 Wilf。 帮助！ 说 Wilf。

sentences.en: "I said 'you'll see' and now you can," said Dad.
sentences.zh: 我说 '你会看见' 和现在你能， 说爸爸。 是， 说爸爸。

sentences.en: He turned on the power.
sentences.zh: 他转动在……上这控制力。

sentences.en: Dad laughed.
sentences.zh: 爸爸笑。

sentences.en: "Surprise!" He said.
sentences.zh: 意想不到的事物！ 他说。 啊唷！

sentences.en: "I wanted you to enjoy the holiday without TV.
sentences.zh: 我想要你到享受这假期没有电视。

sentences.en: There was no power cut."
sentences.zh: 那里是不控制力切。

sentences.en: "Turn it off again," said the children.
sentences.zh: 转动它离开再一次， 说这孩子们。 哦不！ 说这孩子们。

sentences.en: "We can do without it."
sentences.zh: 我们能做没有它。
